issue.title: Cannot subscribe to/from messages using MavlinkPassthrough

comments.body: Which version of MAVSDK are you using?
can you elaborate on that? I built the source code off of main, i did not use a specific release

Oh right, sorry I had missed that in your issue. So [`subscribe_message` does exist](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/main/src/mavsdk/plugins/mavlink_passthrough/mavlink_passthrough_impl.h#L38) indeed, I just wanted to verify that.
Feels like something is wrong in your C++ code. The function exists in the header file, so it seems like you are not calling it correctly.
Any thoughts as to what? I'm following the syntax used in the API so I'm not sure what the issue could be
What error do you get when you call `telemetry.set_rate_attitude_euler(10.0);`?

I get an undefined reference error. 

I just built the code and ran it on a ubuntu 18.04 amd machine and it builds fine. I am wondering if the arm architecture of the Jetson nano could cause any issue.

I also may try pulling the v1.4 release instead of main since I see the API changed

> I get an undefined reference error.

What exactly is the error?
